Verdict block text and next step

reasons: The verdict sits at the top of the phone page with a drawn Failed mark, the word Failed, one plain sentence and a next step. The later Opened event is shown only as an event and the page says open reports are not delivery reports, so the bounce never reads as delivered. Every time shows UTC, no retry is promised, and the page uses the product's own words.
